newsitem.title: USA: Kmart, DAKA end joint venture talks.
newsitem.headline: Kmart, DAKA end joint venture talks.

text.p: Discount chain Kmart Corp. and restaurant operator DAKA International Inc. said Wednesday they ended discussions to establish a joint venture company to operate restaurants in Kmart and Super Kmart stores.
The Troy, Mich.-based retailer and Danvers, Mass.-based operator and franchiser of Fuddruckers and Champps restaurants had signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture in July.

"While it is unfortunate that the joint venture could not be completed, the business analysis of the past several months will help us explore other options to improve the financial performance and efficiency of our restaurant operations," said Floyd Hall, chief executive officer of Kmart.
Kmart stock was unchanged at $9.875 in morning trade on the New York Stock Exchange. DAKA was 37.5 cents lower at $9.625 on the Nasdaq market.
